target: Implement the ratified P1 MCP fleet control plane: registry-backed identity, v2 catalog compatibility/cutover, service leases, ownership evidence, generic atomic materialization, and read-only reconciliation without service topology flips.
invariants: P1 is L3 fleet-control-plane implementation. It may change MCP control-plane code and the catalog representation, but it may not flip any service to its target topology.

Canonical project/workspace/instance identity is registry-issued. Filesystem path, git common-dir, origin, cwd, environment, port, container, MCP session/process identity, and clientInfo remain locator/evidence only.
UNKNOWN or CONFLICTING identity must force mutable_routing_allowed=false and must never authorize start/stop/adopt/reconcile mutation.
No registry record is auto-created from path, cwd, environment, port, container labels, MCP session, clientInfo, or probe result.
The identity registry is operational control-plane authority only; it does not become ConPort, dope-memory, Task Orchestrator, Leantime, DCP, or repository domain authority.

mcp_catalog.yaml remains the single hand-edited fleet source. A v2 catalog cutover is permitted only after exact compatibility projection proves existing client placement, profile membership, endpoint, command, and environment-key semantics unchanged.
If v2 compatibility is not byte/semantic-equivalent at the normalized contract layer, P1 stops before changing mcp_catalog.yaml or the bundled default catalog.
Service lease v2 is endpoint authority only. Port formulas, filesystem paths, labels, compose names, and service-family probes do not independently prove ownership.
mutation_eligible=true requires OWNED classification with registry binding, exact active lease, service-family probe, and storage/mount corroboration all verified.
Generic materialization writes only to an explicit caller-supplied session/output directory and must never rewrite shared/global Claude, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini, or Copilot configuration.
P1 materialization is runner-agnostic foundation only. P7 owns runner-specific rendering, inherited-surface hardening, and activation.
P1 reconcile/adopt is read-only planning. It exposes no Docker/container/database/Redis/service adoption or migration executor.
ConPort remains WORKTREE_SCOPED; ConPort Wave 2 remains unauthorized.
dope-memory is not migrated in P1.
redis-events project isolation remains P5 and must precede dope-memory P4 consolidation.
Serena remains WORKTREE_SCOPED in V1; host sharing remains deferred.
Task Orchestrator project-scope migration remains P3 and is not implemented or activated here.
MCP SDK/protocol upgrade remains PX. P1 must not modify pyproject.toml or uv.lock.
No new general MCP gateway, canonical domain store, always-running lifecycle daemon, or multi_project_singleton is introduced.
No live runtime mutation is permitted during implementation or validation. Registry/lease write tests must use injected temporary paths.

execution.stacked_because: Not stacked. Executed in a fresh isolated worktree from main after explicit operator P1 execution authorization.

pr.title: feat(mcp): implement multiproject P1 fleet control plane
pr.body:
## Summary
- registry-backed project/workspace/instance identity
- catalog-v2 compatibility compiler and guarded cutover
- service-lease-v2 and ownership evidence
- generic atomic materialization and read-only reconcile

## Boundaries
- no service topology flip
- no live runtime mutation during implementation/validation
- no ConPort Wave 2
- no MCP SDK dependency change
- no shared global runner-config rewrite
- merge and activation remain operator-only

## Audit
- L3: one final independent different-family/runtime audit on the frozen substantive head

steps.task: Bind current main, P0 closure, the complete v1 catalog/identity consumer census, open-PR overlap, and rollback boundary before editing.
requirements: Authoring observation main=328a31e9a48bc20c29f4d1cde79273f587d987ee; reharvest at dispatch and classify drift by affected paths rather than SHA inequality alone.
Read root/scoped AGENTS.md and current P0 identity/sharing ADR, topology, falsification contract, schemas, and MCP runtime modules.
Inventory every consumer of scope/state_scope/port_policy and every resolve_project_identity/ProjectIdentity/PortLeaseRegistry caller before editing.
Reharvest #1297 and #1271 exact changed paths. Authoring classification: #1297 disjoint; #1271 is the PX SDK lane and changes pyproject.toml/uv.lock only.
Use a new isolated worktree; never reuse R0/P0 worktrees.
validation: Exact base/current main, branch, and clean worktree are recorded.
Every runtime consumer requiring mutation is already inside the packet allowlist.
If a required consumer is outside the allowlist, stop BLOCKED_P1_ALLOWLIST_INCOMPLETE rather than widening this packet in place.

steps.task: Implement explicit registry-issued project/workspace/instance identity and fail-closed resolution.
requirements: Create atomic JSON identity registry schema_version=dopemux.mcp.identity-registry.v1 with monotonically increasing generation.
IDs are issued only by explicit register_project/register_workspace/register_instance operations; path/env/probe evidence never auto-registers.
Use persistent random IDs prefixed prj_/ws_/inst_; persistent registry records, not deterministic path hashes, provide stability.
Production load(create_missing=False) is read-only when absent; tests inject tmp_path and never touch home registry.
resolve_execution_identity takes explicit actor_id/client_id, verifies alias/membership/claims, detects alias collisions, and returns VERIFIED|CONFLICTING|UNKNOWN.
Every resolver output validates against schemas/mcp/resolved-execution-identity.schema.json.
project_identity.py becomes locator compatibility only; new authoritative callers use identity.py.
validation: Relocated/symlinked worktrees retain stable project_id only through registered aliases.
Identical directory basenames across projects never collide.
Unknown alias, alias collision, wrong project/workspace/instance claim, invalid membership, or stale generation fails closed.
No canonical identifier is derived from path/git/env/port/container/MCP session/clientInfo.

steps.task: Implement v2 catalog loader/compiler and compatibility projection, then conditionally cut root/default catalogs to v2 only under zero semantic drift.
requirements: load_root_catalog_v2 validates raw v2 against schemas/mcp/fleet-catalog-v2.schema.json.
compile_catalog_v2 joins current services to docs/03-reference/mcp/multiproject-service-topology.json and preserves transport/endpoint/command/profile/tool metadata.

Legacy runner placement is not service sharing_class; preserve current global/per-worktree client placement in explicit compatibility defaults and project an in-memory legacy scope only for old renderers.
Stored v2 server objects contain no scope/state_scope/port_policy/multi_project_singleton.
Before catalog mutation compare normalized v1 vs compiled-v2 profile membership, placement, endpoints, commands/args, environment key names, tool/admin/aux metadata.
Only zero semantic drift permits writing mcp_catalog.yaml and bundled default_catalog.yaml as version 2.
target_class remains inert data and cannot trigger start/topology behavior.
validation: Raw v2 catalog validates under the P0 v2 schema.
All 26 topology rows are mapped or explicitly non-catalog infrastructure; any ambiguous service mapping blocks cutover.
Normalized legacy/client semantics are identical before/after projection.
Any semantic difference stops before writing catalog files.

steps.task: Implement service lease v2 endpoint authority with atomic persistence and read-only legacy migration preview.
requirements: Lease records validate against schemas/mcp/service-lease-v2.schema.json.
Lease key is service_id for HOST_SINGLETON, project_id+service_id for PROJECT_SCOPED, and project_id+instance_id+service_id for WORKTREE_SCOPED.
RETIRED never acquires a lease; stale/unknown/conflicting leases never authorize endpoint selection for mutation.
owner_epoch changes on ownership change; registry_generation binds the identity generation used to allocate/verify.
Port/path/labels are endpoint/evidence only.
Legacy PortLeaseRegistry may be read into MigrationPreview only; no live legacy registry import/write is authorized.
commands: uv run --extra test pytest -q tests/mcp/test_service_leases_v2.py tests/unit/test_mcp_runtime_registry.py
validation: Project leases are reusable across worktrees only for the same canonical project_id.
Worktree leases cannot cross instance_id.
Stale generation, retired class, wrong project/instance, malformed endpoint, or conflicting owner fails closed.
Migration preview performs no file/runtime mutation.

steps.task: Implement ownership evidence evaluation without allowing labels, ports, or probes to launder mutation authority.
requirements: Decision validates against schemas/mcp/ownership-evidence.schema.json.
Classification is OWNED|FOREIGN|AMBIGUOUS|UNKNOWN.
mutation_eligible=true requires registry binding, exact active lease, service-family probe, and storage/mount corroboration all verified.
Labels and service-family probes are corroborating evidence only.
docker_inspect.py changes only structured read-only evidence extraction.
validation: Label-only/probe-only/port-only candidates never become mutation eligible.
Foreign expected-port owner is FOREIGN or AMBIGUOUS, never adopted.
Unlabeled right-family service stays UNKNOWN until exact ownership evidence closes.

steps.task: Implement runner-agnostic atomic session materialization and provenance receipts without shared/global config writes.
requirements: Materializer accepts caller-supplied file payloads only; runner-specific rendering stays P7.
Writes are confined to explicit output root using temp generation, fsync, and atomic replacement.
Known shared/global Claude/Codex/OpenCode/Gemini/Copilot config paths are rejected.
Failure leaves the previous complete generation intact.
Receipt validates runner-materialization-receipt schema and authority=PROVENANCE_ONLY.
validation: Injected failure never leaves mixed generations.
Global/home runner config paths are rejected.
Strict mode cannot succeed with UNKNOWN inherited-surface status.

steps.task: Compose identity, catalog, leases, ownership and materialization inputs into a read-only reconcile/control-plane plan.
requirements: Reconcile statuses are MATCHED|MISSING|FOREIGN|AMBIGUOUS|STALE|LEGACY_UNBOUND.
Reconcile emits recommendations/data only and has no start/stop/rm/adopt/migrate executor.
ControlPlanePlan contains resolved identity, selected service specs, lease/endpoints, ownership evidence, materialization inputs, and blockers.
Existing fleet/runtime_state may consume canonical identity for read decisions; v2 mutation behavior stays dormant/default-off.
docker_runtime may add v2 label-construction helpers but may not alter topology/start behavior absent a later activation gate.
mcp_commands may expose read-only identity/catalog/reconcile preview surfaces only; no auto-registration or live mutation.
commands: uv run --extra test pytest -q tests/mcp/test_reconcile_v2.py tests/mcp/test_control_plane_v2.py tests/unit/test_mcp_commands_catalog.py tests/unit/test_mcp_doctor_repo_aware.py
validation: Two projects with identical basenames yield distinct canonical plans.
Two worktrees of one project retain distinct instance_id while sharing project identity.
Wrong-project lease, stale lease, foreign port, absent registry, alias collision, and stale materialization all block with zero mutation.
No P2/P3/P4/P5/P6/P7 activation occurs.

steps.task: Document dormant P1 behavior, compatibility projection, identity/lease locations, activation boundary, and rollback.
requirements: Documentation states merge does not activate service topology changes.
Document production registry/lease paths but state implementation/validation must not write live/home state.
Document catalog-v2 compatibility gate and cutover stop condition.
Before activation rollback is git revert of the P1 merge; no runtime cleanup is expected.
Any observed live state mutation is FAIL_P1_UNAUTHORIZED_RUNTIME_MUTATION.
validation: Docs make no ConPort Wave2/service migration/runner activation/SDK upgrade/merge/activation claim.

steps.task: Run L3 pre-push gates, freeze one substantive head, obtain one independent different-family/runtime final audit, close proof-only evidence, and stop for operator merge decision.
requirements: Before first push run exact identity, allowlist, diff, packet/schema/frontmatter, focused/relevant suites, changed-file pre-commit, exact-range secret scan, and no-live-runtime-mutation checks.
Do not audit intermediate commits.
Auditor must be independent of implementer; exact runner/model is live-discovered and recorded. No silent fallback.
At most one bounded substantive repair; after repair rerun all deterministic gates, freeze a new head, and run one fresh final audit.
Proof-only successor preserves audit only after schema/signature/ancestry/path-closure validation.
PR Steward runs only after current review settlement and exact-head evidence.
No merge, service activation, ConPort Wave2, or P2-P8 dispatch.
